scope: Advisory source review and final improvement proposal; no product implementation or live Streamlit qualification.

decision.keep: Existing React desktop/shared web control surface and canonical AX Code runtime.
decision.prioritize: Approval copy and recovery, real Peek rendering evidence, truthful review state and discoverability.
decision.investigate: Timeboxed Streamlit project preview through ordinary browser and existing project actions.
decision.defer: Full second Streamlit controller; internal read-only diagnostics until a concrete audience/job.

corrections: Ordinary preview and Agent Browser are distinct. Ordinary preview uses a persistent shared partition; do not claim project cookie isolation or copy Agent Browser download policy.
Local Streamlit viewing needs no WebMCP grant or URL allowlist expansion.
Reuse existing terminal-owned Project Actions, not a new Python process supervisor. Manual URL attachment owns no process. Closing preview must not kill the server.
Both conflicting decisions remain disabled in flight and while the outcome is unresolved; the UI guard is not authoritative runtime authorization.
A second thin frontend is not inherently a second runtime. ADR-015 is naming. The objection to a duplicate GUI is demand and maintenance cost.
Allow is once-only already; clarify copy without changing behavior. Fourteen locale catalogs exist.
Peek narrow clipping remains a hypothesis because current visual fixtures bypass the real Peek.
Streamlit supports forms, fragments and streaming; Session State does not establish durable run ownership.
The project has not established a Python SDK contract; no general claim about worldwide SDK availability is made.

independent_post_review_findings.finding: Canonical sdk.permission.list exists; sdk.question.list exists at line 240. No new runtime endpoint is required merely to inspect pending requests.

resyncBlockingRequestsForDirectory merges concurrent SSE safely, but also performs existing auto-accept behavior at lines 712-740. Do not call the full helper blindly for read-only failure reconciliation; retain routing and event freshness and avoid introducing automatic reply side effects.
Configured preview URL opens before command submission at line 637. Validate readiness and retry before adding a generic server readiness redesign.

plan_estimates_engineering_days.scope: Render real MissionControlPeek at 420/760/1440 and 200% zoom; keyboard/focus checks; fix layout only if reproduced.
Allow once copy; visible sending and uncertain state; inline errors; read-only canonical reconciliation; duplicate/stale/late-response/unmount regressions.
Review copy describes changes awaiting review; keep enums; explicit existing inspector labels preference; locale consistency.

Single-platform Streamlit preview spike with existing project environment/actions; core widgets/forms/streaming, file transfer, reload/reconnect, restart, port collision, two projects, ownership and external fallback.
Conditional project action recipe and evidenced readiness/retry glue; explicit interpreter and entrypoint; reuse existing terminal ownership.

qualification_limits: Estimates are not measurements or release schedules. Cross-platform qualification is additional.
Core embedded widgets/forms/streaming must work in ordinary preview to claim embedded support. External-browser success alone qualifies only an external-launch workflow.
Record upload/download/authentication and shared-profile limitations rather than silently weakening CORS/XSRF or agent permissions.
This review did not run the Streamlit compatibility spike, native end-to-end tests, or accessibility user testing.
Preserve accepted requirements; any later requirements change is an additive versioned proposal.
